The '''Latoma system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. The system's star was a [[Red dwarf/Legends|red dwarf]], and the system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Latoma]] and the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Brugga]], which was the secret base that [[Ti'mere's InfoServices]] operated from. Several other asteroids and [[Comet/Legends|comets]] were also present in the system. Due to the system's remote location and the fact that Latoma was not considered to be a useful planet, the Latoma system was not considered for commercial development.<ref name="FBS" />
